entries.causal_hypothesis: A single pre-entry 5-day or 20-day market-state bin consistently determines continuation versus reversal across all four development folds.
entries.decision: Close RQ-020B. Do not create a router, interaction or threshold refinement from the tested states.
falsified_or_unsupported_claims: one coarse pre-entry multi-day state is sufficient for a robust continuation/reversal router
entries.origin_analysis: Exact fixed-strategy portability and static portfolios failed; 2023H1 was broadly adverse while later development folds were stronger.
pre_result_predictions: at least one predeclared state has one preferred action in all four folds
the preferred action is default/severe positive and robust in all folds
the state has breadth across at least three fixed strategies
prohibited_reuse: no relaxation of monthly breadth or ex-best-two gates
retained_findings: upper-third 20-day range position favors continuation under default and severe cost in all four folds
most other state bins reverse preferred action between 2023H1 and later folds
long-horizon market position is more informative than prior local B02 partitions but remains insufficient
successor_questions: does the complete frozen R1 Entry x R2 horizon universe contain a family-level cross-fold robust region that was missed by the 2024H1-only R4 selection path?

entries.causal_hypothesis: A family-level region of the already frozen Entry/horizon universe may be positive and stable across 2023H1, 2023H2, 2024H1 and 2024H2 even when the 2024H1-only representative selection and five-strategy portability path fails.
entries.decision: Preregister a descriptive family-level four-fold architecture census before opening outcomes. Do not select a single candidate in the census stage.
entries.origin_analysis: R2 and R3 evaluated all 60 frozen R1 v2 Entry definitions x 11 horizons only on 2024H1. R4-R6 reduced the universe to eight representatives and five complete strategies; candidate-specific 2024H2 was opened only for those five, and no complete 660-combination census exists on exact 2023.
pre_result_predictions: all 60 Entry definitions and 11 horizons can be regenerated without changes
the accepted R2 2024H1 surface can be reproduced exactly
family-level cross-fold metrics can be reported without selecting a single maximum
at most one family-level region will justify a later finite successor
prohibited_reuse: no horizon expansion beyond the frozen eleven
no filtering to R4/R6 winners before the census
no reopening closed exact candidates as passed
retained_findings: R2/R3 H1-only surface is complete and source-locked
R6/V1 exposed only five strategies to H2
fixed-five and simple regime router paths are closed
successor_questions: which frozen family/horizon neighbourhood, if any, has adequate support and consistent economics across all four folds?
